reuse.why: Routes every amount calculation through the existing exported getScheduledAmount and computes the approximate tolerance with the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline midpoint copies (schedules/app.ts x2, forecast, schedule-template, preview) in favour of the one helper, adding no new copies.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, already consumed by both server and client, and the API field is added in the scheduleModel.toExternal mapper with a named API type.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and the API field, though extending toExternal's return type means every user of the mapper now carries expectedAmount, not just the list endpoint.

maintainability.why: A single well-tested definition with op as the real input; minor wrinkles are the redundant Math.round around Math.min and inserting op before the existing positional inverse flag.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts gains an op parameter and an isapprox branch; these carry the real domain variation and all former inline copies now call it
